The current incomplete month is excluded. The forecast is for next calendar month, two months after the last complete month. The historical evaluation uses the same horizon.
History begins in the month of the first recorded expense. Missing entries may distort the forecast.
This estimate is based on the logbook. A short-term average cannot predict rare costly repairs or seasonal changes.
MAE requires at least 5 complete months: 3 for the forecast, one excluded month and one for comparison against actual expenses. Accuracy comparison is not yet available.
Few historical months were evaluated. A longer history will make the comparison more informative. Lower MAE on these data does not guarantee future accuracy.
Months without entries after history begins count as zero expenses. Check for missing data.
Each forecast uses only earlier months. MAE is the mean absolute error in PLN. Lower is better.
All expenses in the selected period. Each refuelling and paid service appears once. UTF-8 with BOM, amounts in PLN. Limited to 25,000 rows and 10 MB. Choose a shorter period if needed.
